The '''siege''' of [[Ilum]] was, according to ancient sources and a nearly forgotten legend, a conflict during which [[Sith]] took control of the [[planet]] for a time.<ref name="NoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siege of Ilum was first mentioned in [[canon]] in ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', a [[2016]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="NoP" />
